newsitem.title: CHINA: China, Russia reach pact on border forces.
newsitem.headline: China, Russia reach pact on border forces.

text.p: China, Russia and three other former Soviet republics have reached a comprehensive accord on reducing forces along their borders, the official Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

The agency said the agreement reached in the Chinese capital wound up seven years of talks on the issue. Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan were also represented at the latest round of talks, it said.
Xinhua gave no details about the timing or extent of troop reductions and did not say when a formal pact would be signed.
An agreement was reached after 16 days of talks that were described as being held in a friendly and pragmatic atmosphere, it said.
The parties signed a confidence building agreement in April, pledging not to attack each other.
